summary: Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007 s.23 interpretation; beneficial legislation requires purposive, liberal construction; Tribunal empowered to set aside gift deed for failure to provide basic amenities even without explicit condition; High Court erred in narrowly construing jurisdiction; constitutional duty to care for senior citizens; social justice; appeal allowed.
legal_provisions_cited: Maintenance and Welfare of the Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007 s.22, s.23
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment set aside; orders of Tribunal and Single Judge restored.
